moments.action: In the sunlit sitting room Amah pushes a hand through her thin white hair, head down, while M sits on the floor below her chair; the cut tightens until her arm has come over the armrest to rest against him.
M points his phone at Amah and they watch the screen together, both laughing as she bats at his arm; the screen starts on her own face and ends with her swapped into a bald old man.
One long held take against the bright window: Amah laughs openly, teeth showing, then the frame settles on M looking up at her, no longer smiling, his hand closed around her wrist.
A dark commuter train slides past in tight overhead shots, then the camera pulls wide to palms and sky where a rainbow stands; the train crosses beneath it and clears the frame.
